mentions.name: fetchfavicon.com
mentions.description: A web service that retrieves the best quality favicon from any website, with upcoming support for batch favicon requests that bundle multiple URLs into a single image sprite.
mentions.problem: Existing favicon services like icon.horse were unreliable and sometimes down, so the author wanted something more dependable.
mentions.audience: Builds a more reliable favicon source for the author's own use after a previously used service had outages.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a new project: https://fetchfavicon.com for getting the best quality favicon from any website.

evidence.value: Currently working on a new project: https://fetchfavicon.com for getting the best quality favicon from any website.
